mintAuthority.summary: USDh's sole authored Stacks deployment is the canonical native-issuance route. Mints require a two-step backend attestation: a KYC-whitelisted minter calls request-mint and deposits BTC, then Hermetica's trader opens the delta-neutral hedge off-chain and calls confirm-mint to release USDh, making supply gated by Hermetica's off-chain operator. No bridge representation or bridge administrator is evidenced, so bridge machinery is outside Mint Authority.

controls.label: Hermetica hq-v1 minting contracts (confirm-mint operators)
controls.evidence: Hiro API read of hq-v1 minting-contracts map: two contracts are currently active — minting-otc-v1-1 (burn-block-height=some(927047)) and emergency-recover-v1 (burn-block-height=some(862013)), both deployed by SPN5AKG35QZSK2M8GAMR4AFX45659RJHDW353HSG (Hermetica deployer). minting-otc-v1-1 is the primary OTC minting route; emergency-recover-v1 is an emergency recovery contract. minting-auto-v1-1 was deactivated 2026-03-23 and removed. No permissionless mint path exists. Native issuance route checks retained from the former routeChecks block: signingModel = "USDh minting is two-step: KYC-whitelisted minter request/deposit first, then Hermetica confirm-mint operators release USDh after off-chain hedge execution."; onchainAmountBounds = "hq-v1 minting-contracts map limits active mint routes to reviewed contracts; no permissionless mint path exists."; pausersAdminsUpgraders = "New minting contracts and owner changes are subject to the hq-v1 1008-block timelock." These checks govern Stacks-native issuance, not a bridge route.
controls.capDescription: minting-otc-v1-1 confirm-mint is bounded by a rolling mint-limit (live: 1,000,000 USDh per 1,200s window); set-mint-limit asserts new-limit <= the max-mint-limit constant (1,000,000 USDh), so the confirm-mint operators cannot raise the ceiling.

controls.label: hq-v1 owner (SM1QXYXZG... — Stacks P2SH/multisig address)
controls.evidence: Hiro API get-owner read on hq-v1: owner data-var returns Clarity bytes 0x05146fdf77f03a1ace4bf29f8090067a98c65000e1e2, decoded via c32check (version byte 20 = SM P2SH/multisig prefix) to SM1QXYXZG78DCWJZJKY0901KTK3350071W9YYRPMT. This is a Stacks P2SH multisig address (SM prefix) — signers and threshold not enumerated on-chain. Ownership transferred from deployer SP1N0K23NJTRK19SV9BFP8SVXQQFQ7XGGBFJ8DBVX via 2-step timelock (request-owner-update nonce 24, activate-next-owner nonce 25, executed 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-10). hq-v1 enforces a 1008-block (~7 day) timelock on owner changes and minting-contract additions. Native issuance route checks retained from the former routeChecks block: pausersAdminsUpgraders = "hq-v1 owner is a Stacks P2SH/multisig address and owner changes/new minting contracts use a 1008-block timelock."; unsupportedReason = "Stacks P2SH signer set and threshold were not enumerated on-chain." These checks govern native hq-v1 administration, not bridge machinery.
controls.capDescription: hq-v1 owner can register and activate a new minting contract with any cap (1,008 burn-block timelock) and can set-contract-active a protocol contract that calls minting-otc-v1-1.set-mint-limit, so the effective mint ceiling is owner-raiseable.

controls.label: Minter whitelist (KYC/KYB gate)
controls.evidence: Only KYC/KYB-approved participants whitelisted by Hermetica can request mints/redemptions directly; access to the mint route is administered off-chain by the issuer. Native issuance route checks retained from the former routeChecks block: signingModel = "Only KYC/KYB-approved participants can request direct mints/redemptions; Hermetica administers this off-chain whitelist."; unsupportedReason = "The off-chain whitelist administration process and signer controls are issuer-operated and not enumerated on-chain." These checks govern the native KYC/KYB gate, not bridge machinery.
controls.capDescription: The minter whitelist gates who may request a mint (minting-state-v1 whitelist map, whitelist-enabled = true); it carries no cap-setting function.

review.evidence: Hiro API reads on hq-v1 (SPN5AKG35QZSK2M8GAMR4AFX45659RJHDW353HSG.hq-v1): (1) owner = SM1QXYXZG78DCWJZJKY0901KTK3350071W9YYRPMT (SM-prefix P2SH multisig, transferred 2026-02-10 via 1008-block timelock); (2) active minting-contracts: minting-otc-v1-1 (primary OTC route) and emergency-recover-v1, both deployed by Hermetica deployer; minting-auto-v1-1 deactivated 2026-03-23. No permissionless mint path. hq-v1 enforces 7-day timelock on owner changes and new minting-contract activations. Minting model confirmed as backend-attested OTC with a multisig-governed admin layer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: activating a replacement minting contract requires the enforced 1008-block delay, monthly dated custodian reports reconcile supply to backing, and no named regulator or independent assurance provider is evidenced. Boundary migration (2026-08-16): all three controls and the hq-v1 upgradeability entry govern the sole Stacks native-issuance deployment; their former routeChecks are native issuance checks preserved in control evidence, not bridge machinery. No bridge representation, bridge administrator, or bridgeRouteRisk route is evidenced.
